title: Range-Bound Markets

fixes.replaceWith: { yAxis: 99, label: "Resistance → flips to Support", color: "#ff2e88" }
fixes.reason: The lesson explicitly teaches 'After a breakout: old resistance becomes new support (S/R flip) — buy the retest', but the chart only ever labels 99 as resistance. Relabeling the single existing line teaches the flip without adding a second markLine at the identical yAxis (which would collide pills). Color stays pink because the line is drawn at the resistance/pre-break role; the new wording carries the flip concept.

edits.reason: Closes the taught-but-not-drawn S/R flip concept via a label fix on the existing resistance line. No retest markPoint is added: the breakout legs run 86→110 with no retouch of 99, so a 'buy the retest' candle event has no bar to anchor to and would be an invention.

fixes.reason: The explanation names the target as 'range high at $97' but the resistance markLine is drawn at 96. Moving it to 97 reconciles the drawn level with the taught value. Kept as a neutral pink 'Resistance (range high)' level — legitimate decision context visible pre-cut. NOT recolored gold or labeled 'Target': gold = target magnet and a 'Target' pill pre-reveal would nudge the learner toward the correct bullish answer ('target the range high'). 97 sits at the top of the chart band (max leg .to is the 97 reveal leg), so it does not clip.

edits.reason: The explanation teaches 'Target: range high at $97' as the trade objective. The pre-cut chart and existing reveal points (Hammer idx15, Bounce idx16) show the entry and the bounce but never the target being reached. The post-bounce leg ltCandles(90,[{to:97,bars:4}]) runs idx16–19, so the price reaches 97 at idx19 — annotating it as a revealMarkPoint shows the outcome AFTER the user answers, so it does not spoil the cut decision. Gold = take-profit/target magnet per palette.

notes: introChart correctly teaches the range concept (Resistance + Support zones, alternating Rejected/Bought touches) — no gap; auditor's alreadyComplete is right. lessonChart: accepted the auditor's S/R-flip fix but implemented as a single relabel of the existing line rather than a duplicate teal markLine at the same yAxis (would overlap). quiz.chart: accepted the 96 vs 97 reconciliation but REJECTED the auditor's gold 'Resistance / Target' recolor (gold + 'Target' pre-cut hints the bullish answer); kept neutral pink range-high level at 97 and instead routed the taught target to a post-reveal gold markPoint at idx19 where the bounce leg actually reaches 97 — the auditor missed that the target reach can be shown safely in revealMarkPoints. Rule of Fives / fake-out concepts taught in lesson text are not locatable levels on these specific charts, so no annotation proposed for them.
